Arabic text: بِسْمِ اللَّـهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِاللَّهِ الَانْصَاري
Translation: Narrated from Jabir ibn Abdullah al-Ansari

Arabic text: عَنْ فَاطِمَةَ الزَّهْرَاءِ عَلَيْهَا السَّلامُ بِنْتِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ قَالَ
Translation: From Fatima al-Zahra, peace be upon her, daughter of the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, who said:

Arabic text: سَمِعْتُ فَاطِمَةَ اَنَّهَا قَالَتْ
Translation: I heard Fatima say:

Arabic text: دَخَلَ عَلَيَّ اَبِيْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ فِيْ بَعْضِ الْأَيَّامِ
Translation: My father, the Messenger of Allah, came to me one day

Arabic text: فَقَالَ اَلسَّلامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا فَاطِمَةُ
Translation: And said, "Peace be upon you, O Fatima"

Arabic text: فَقُلْتُ عَلَيْكَ السَّلامُ
Translation: I replied, "And peace be upon you"

Arabic text: قَالَ اِنِّيْ اَجِدُ فِيْ بَدَنِيْ ضُعْفًا
Translation: He said, "I feel weakness in my body"

Arabic text: فَقُلْتُ لَهُ اُعيذُكَ بِاللَّهِ يَا اَبَتَاهُ مِنَ الضُّعْفِ
Translation: I said to him, "I seek Allah's protection for you, O father, from weakness"

Arabic text: فَقَالَ يَا فَاطِمَةُ اِيْتِيْنِيْ بِالْكِسَاءِ الْيَمَانِيْ فَغَطِّيْنِيْ بِهِ
Translation: He said, "O Fatima, bring me the Yemeni cloak and cover me with it"

Arabic text: فَاَتَيْتُهُ بِالْكِسَاءِ الْيَمَانِيْ فَغَطَّيْتُهُ بِهِ
Translation: So I brought him the Yemeni cloak and covered him with it

Arabic text: وَصِرْتُ اَنْظُرُ اِلَيْهِ وَ اِذَا وَجْهُهُ يَتَلَأْلَؤُ
Translation: I was looking at him and his face was shining

Arabic text: كَاَنَّهُ الْبَدْرُ فِيْ لَيْلَةِ تَمَامِهِ وَكَمَالِهِ
Translation: Like the full moon on the night of its perfection and completeness

Arabic text: فَمَا كَانَتْ اِلَّا سَاعَةً وَ اِذَا بِوَلَدِيَ الْحَسَنِ قَدْ اَقْبَلَ
Translation: After a while, my son Hassan came

Arabic text: وَقَالَ اَلسَّلامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا اُمَّاهُ
Translation: And said, "Peace be upon you, O mother"

Arabic text: فَقُلْتُ وَعَلَيْكَ السَّلامُ يَا قُرَّةَ عَيْنِيْ وَثَمَرَةَ فُؤادي
Translation: I replied, "And peace be upon you, O coolness of my eyes and fruit of my heart"

Arabic text: فَقَالَ يَا اُمَّاهُ اِنِّيْ اَشَمُّ عِنْدَكِ رَائِحَةً طَيِّبَةً
Translation: He said, "O mother, I smell a sweet fragrance here

Arabic text: كَاَنَّهَا رَائِحَةُ جَدِّيْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ
Translation: Like the fragrance of my grandfather, the Messenger of Allah"

Arabic text: فَقُلْتُ نَعَمْ اِنَّ جَدَّكَ تَحْتَ الْكِسَاءِ
Translation: I said, "Yes, your grandfather is under the cloak"

Arabic text: فَاَقْبَلَ الْحَسَنُ نَحْوَ الْكِسَاءِ وَقَالَ اَلسَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا جَدَّاهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ
Translation: Hassan approached the cloak and said, "Peace be upon you, O grandfather, O Messenger of Allah

Arabic text: اَتَأْذَنُ لِيْ اَنْ اَدْخُلَ مَعَكَ تَحْتَ الْكِسَاءِ
Translation: Do you permit me to enter with you under the cloak?"

Arabic text: فَقَالَ وَعَلَيْكَ السَّلامُ يَا وَلَدِيْ وَيَا صَاحِبَ حَوْضي
Translation: He replied, "Peace be upon you, O my son and O keeper of my pond

Arabic text: قَدْ اَذِنْتُ لَكَ
Translation: I permit you"

Arabic text: فَدَخَلَ مَعَهُ تَحْتَ الْكِسَاءِ
Translation: So he entered with him under the cloak

Arabic text: فَمَا كَانَتْ اِلَّا سَاعَةً وَ اِذَا بِوَلَدِيَ الْحُسَيْنِ قَدْ اَقْبَلَ وَقَالَ
Translation: After a while, my son Hussain came and said,

Arabic text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا اُمَّاهُ
Translation: "Peace be upon you, O mother"

Arabic text: فَقُلْتُ وَعَلَيْكَ السَّلامُ يَا وَلَدِيْ وَيَا قُرَّةَ عَيْنِيْ وَثَمَرَةَ فُؤادي
Translation: I replied, "And peace be upon you, O my son and coolness of my eyes and fruit of my heart"

Arabic text: فَقَالَ لِيْ يَا اُمَّاهُ اِنِّيْ اَشَمُّ عِنْدَكِ رَائِحَةً طَيِّبَةً
Translation: He said to me, "O mother, I smell a sweet fragrance here

Arabic text: كَاَنَّهَا رَائِحَةُ جَدِّيْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: Like the fragrance of my grandfather, the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family"

Arabic text: فَقُلْتُ نَعَمْ اِنَّ جَدَّكَ وَاَخَاكَ تَحْتَ الْكِسَاءِ
Translation: I said, "Yes, your grandfather and your brother are under the cloak"

Arabic text: فَدَنَى الْحُسَيْنُ نَحْوَ الْكِسَاءِ
Translation: Hussain approached the cloak

Arabic text: وَقَالَ اَلسَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا جَدَّاهُ اَلسَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَنِ اخْتَارَهُ اللَّهُ
Translation: And said, "Peace be upon you, O grandfather. Peace be upon you, O chosen one of Allah

Arabic text: اَتَأْذَنُ لِيْ اَنْ اَكُوْنَ مَعَكُمَا تَحْتَ الْكِسَاءِ
Translation: Do you permit me to be with you both under the cloak?"

Arabic text: فَقَالَ وَعَلَيْكَ السَّلامُ يَا وَلَدي
Translation: He replied, "Peace be upon you, O my son

Arabic text: وَيَا شَافِعَ اُمَّتِيْ قَدْ اَذِنْتُ لَكَ
Translation: And O intercessor of my nation, I permit you"

Arabic text: فَدَخَلَ مَعَهُمَا تَحْتَ الْكِسَاءِ
Translation: So he entered with them under the cloak

Arabic text: فَاَقْبَلَ عِنْدَ ذٰلِكَ اَبُوْالحَسَنِ عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَبِيْ طَالِبٍ
Translation: Then Abu al-Hassan Ali ibn Abi Talib came

Arabic text: وَقَالَ اَلسَّلامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ
Translation: And said, "Peace be upon you, O daughter of the Messenger of Allah"

Arabic text: فَقُلْتُ وَعَلَيْكَ السَّلامُ يَا اَبَا الْحَسَنِ وَ يَا اَمِيْرَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ
Translation: I replied, "And peace be upon you, O Abu al-Hassan and O Commander of the Faithful"

Arabic text: فَقَالَ يَا فَاطِمَةُ اِنِّيْ اَشَمُّ عِنْدَكِ رَائِحَةً طَيِّبَةً
Translation: He said, "O Fatima, I smell a sweet fragrance here

Arabic text: كَاَنَّهَا رَائِحَةُ اَخِيْ وَابْنِ عَمِّيْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ
Translation: Like the fragrance of my brother and cousin, the Messenger of Allah"

Arabic text: فَقُلْتُ نَعَمْ هَا هُوَ مَعَ وَلَدَيْكَ تَحْتَ الْكِسَاءِ
Translation: I said, "Yes, he is here with your two sons under the cloak"

Arabic text: فَاَقْبَلَ عَلِيٌّ نَحْوَ الْكِسَاءِ
Translation: Ali approached the cloak

Arabic text: وَقَالَ اَلسَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ
Translation: And said, "Peace be upon you, O Messenger of Allah

Arabic text: اَتَأْذَنُ لِيْ اَنْ اَكُوْنَ مَعَكُمْ تَحْتَ الْكِسَاءِ
Translation: Do you permit me to be with you under the cloak?"

Arabic text: قَالَ لَهُ وَعَلَيْكَ السَّلامُ يَا اَخِيْ يَا وَصِيّي
Translation: He said to him, "Peace be upon you, O my brother, O my trustee

Arabic text: وَخَلِيْفَتِيْ وَصَاحِبَ لِوَائِيْ
Translation: My successor, and bearer of my banner

Arabic text: قَدْ اَذِنْتُ لَكَ فَدَخَلَ عَلِيٌّ تَحْتَ الْكِسَاءِ
Translation: I permit you." So Ali entered under the cloak

Arabic text: ثُمَّ اَتَيْتُ نَحْوَ الْكِسَاءِ
Translation: Then I approached the cloak

Arabic text: وَقُلْتُ اَلسَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا اَبَتَاهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ
Translation: And said, "Peace be upon you, O father, O Messenger of Allah

Arabic text: اَتَأْذَنُ لِيْ اَنْ اَكُوْنَ مَعَكُمْ تَحْتَ الْكِسَاءِ
Translation: Do you permit me to be with you under the cloak?"

Arabic text: قَالَ وَعَلَيْكِ السَّلامُ يَا بِنْتِيْ وَيَا بَضْعَتِيْ قَدْ اَذِنْتُ لَكِ
Translation: He said, "Peace be upon you, O my daughter and part of me, I permit you"

Arabic text: فَدَخَلْتُ تَحْتَ الْكِسَاءِ
Translation: So I entered under the cloak

Arabic text: فَلَمَّا اكْتَمَلْنَا جَمِيْعًا تَحْتَ الْكِسَاءِ اَخَذَ اَبِيْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ بِطَرَفَيِ الْكِسَاءِ
Translation: When we were all gathered under the cloak, my father, the Messenger of Allah, took the two edges of the cloak

Arabic text: وَاَوْمَئَ بِيَدِهِ الْيُمْنَى اِلَى السَّمَاءِ وَقَالَ
Translation: And pointed with his right hand toward the sky and said:

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ اِنَّ هٰؤُلَاءِ اَهْلُ بَيْتِيْ وَخَاصَّتِيْ وَحَامَّتِيْ
Translation: "O Allah, these are my family members, my special ones, and my close ones

Arabic text: لَحْمُهُمْ لَحْمِيْ وَدَمُهُمْ دَمِيْ
Translation: Their flesh is my flesh and their blood is my blood

Arabic text: يُؤْلِمُنِيْ مَا يُؤْلِمُهُمْ
Translation: What pains them pains me

Arabic text: وَيَحْزُنُنِيْ مَا يَحْزُنُهُمْ
Translation: And what grieves them grieves me

Arabic text: اَنَا حَرْبٌ لِمَنْ حَارَبَهُمْ
Translation: I am at war with whoever wars against them

Arabic text: وَسِلْمٌ لِمَنْ سَالَمَهُمْ
Translation: And at peace with whoever is at peace with them

Arabic text: وَعَدُوٌّ لِمَنْ عَادَاهُمْ
Translation: And an enemy to whoever is their enemy

Arabic text: وَمُحِبٌّ لِمَنْ اَحَبَّهُمْ
Translation: And a friend to whoever befriends them

Arabic text: اِنَّهُمْ مِنِّيْ وَ اَنَا مِنْهُمْ
Translation: They are from me and I am from them

Arabic text: فَاجْعَلْ صَلَوَاتِكَ وَبَرَكَاتِكَ وَرَحْمَتَكَ
Translation: So place Your blessings, benedictions, mercy

Arabic text: وَغُفْرَانَكَ وَرِضْوَانَكَ عَلَيَّ
Translation: Forgiveness, and pleasure upon me

Arabic text: وَعَلَيْهِمْ وَاَذْهِبْ عَنْهُمُ الرِّجْسَ وَطَهِّرْهُمْ تَطْهيرًا
Translation: And upon them, and remove from them impurity and purify them thoroughly."

Arabic text: فَقَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّوَجَلَّ
Translation: Then Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, said:

Arabic text: يَا مَلَائِكَتِيْ وَيَا سُكَّانَ سَمٰوَاتي
Translation: "O My angels and dwellers of My heavens

Arabic text: اِنِّيْ مَا خَلَقْتُ سَمَاءً مَبْنِيَّةً وَلَا اَرْضًا مَدْحِيَّةً وَلَا قَمَرًا مُنِيْرًا
Translation: I have not created a built sky, nor a spread-out earth, nor a shining moon

Arabic text: وَلَا شَمْسًا مُضِيْئَةً وَلَا فَلَكًا يَدُوْرُ وَلَا بَحْرًا يَجْرِيْ وَلَا فُلْكًا يَسْري
Translation: Nor a bright sun, nor a revolving orbit, nor a flowing sea, nor a sailing ship

Arabic text: اِلَّا فِيْ مَحَبَّةِ هٰؤُلَاءِ الْخَمْسَةِ الَّذِيْنَ هُمْ تَحْتَ الْكِسَاءِ
Translation: Except for the love of these five who are under the cloak."

Arabic text: فَقَالَ الْأَمِيْنُ جِبْرَائِيْلُ يَا رَبِّ وَمَنْ تَحْتَ الْكِسَاءِ
Translation: The Trustworthy Angel Gabriel said, "O Lord, who is under the cloak?"

Arabic text: فَقَالَ عَزَّوَجَلَّ
Translation: The Mighty and Majestic said:

Arabic text: هُمْ اَهْلُ بَيْتِ النُّبُوَّةِ وَمَعْدِنُ الرِّسَالَةِ
Translation: "They are the People of the House of Prophethood and the treasures of the Message

Arabic text: هُمْ فَاطِمَةُ وَاَبُوهَا وَبَعْلُهَا وَبَنُوهَا
Translation: They are Fatima, her father, her husband, and her sons."

Arabic text: فَقَالَ جِبْرَائِيْلُ يَا رَبِّ اَتَأْذَنُ لِيْ اَنْ اَهْبِطَ اِلَى الْأَرْضِ
Translation: Gabriel said, "O Lord, do You permit me to descend to earth

Arabic text: لِأَكُونَ مَعَهُمْ سَادِسًا
Translation: To be with them as the sixth?"

Arabic text: فَقَالَ اللَّهُ نَعَمْ قَدْ اَذِنْتُ لَكَ
Translation: Allah said, "Yes, I permit you."

Arabic text: فَهَبَطَ الْأَمِيْنُ جِبْرَائِيْلُ وَقَالَ اَلسَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ
Translation: So the Trustworthy Gabriel descended and said, "Peace be upon you, O Messenger of Allah

Arabic text: اَلْعَلِيُ الْأَعْلَى يُقْرِئُكَ السَّلامَ وَيَخُصُّكَ بِالتَّحِيَّةِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
Translation: The Most High sends His greetings to you and honors you with special greetings and reverence

Arabic text: وَيَقُولُ لَكَ وَعِزَّتِيْ وَجَلالي
Translation: And says to you, by My Might and Majesty,

Arabic text: اِنِّيْ مَا خَلَقْتُ سَمَاءً مَبْنِيَّةً
Translation: I have not created a built sky

Arabic text: وَلَا اَرْضًا مَدْحِيَّةً وَلَا قَمَرًا مُنِيْرًا وَلَا شَمْسًا مُضيئَةً
Translation: Nor a spread-out earth, nor a shining moon, nor a bright sun

Arabic text: وَلَا فَلَكًا يَدُوْرُ وَلَا بَحْرًا يَجْرِيْ وَلَا فُلْكًا يَسْري
Translation: Nor a revolving orbit, nor a flowing sea, nor a sailing ship

Arabic text: اِلَّا لِأَجْلِكُمْ وَمَحَبَّتِكُمْ
Translation: Except for your sake and your love

Arabic text: وَقَدْ اَذِنَ لِيْ اَنْ اَدْخُلَ مَعَكُمْ
Translation: And He has permitted me to join you

Arabic text: فَهَلْ تَاْذَنُ لِيْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ
Translation: So do you permit me, O Messenger of Allah?"

Arabic text: فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ وَعَلَيْكَ السَّلامُ يَا اَمِيْنَ وَحْيِ اللَّهِ
Translation: The Messenger of Allah replied, "Peace be upon you, O trustee of Allah's revelation

Arabic text: اِنَّهُ نَعَمْ قَدْ اَذِنْتُ لَكَ
Translation: Yes, I permit you."

Arabic text: فَدَخَلَ جِبْرَائِيْلُ مَعَنَا تَحْتَ الْكِسَاءِ
Translation: So Gabriel entered with us under the cloak

Arabic text: فَقَالَ لِأَبِيْ اِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ اَوْحَى اِلَيْكُمْ يَقُوْلُ
Translation: He said to my father, "Allah has revealed to you saying:

Arabic text: اِنَّمَا يُريدُ اللَّهُ لِيُذْهِبَ عَنْكُمُ الرِّجْسَ
Translation: 'Allah only desires to keep away impurity from you,

Arabic text: اَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ وَيُطَهِّرَكُمْ تَطْهيرًا
Translation: O People of the House, and to purify you thoroughly.'"

Arabic text: فَقَالَ عَلِيٌّ لِأَبِيْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ اَخْبِرْنِيْ مَا لِجُلُوسِنَا
Translation: Then Ali said to my father, "O Messenger of Allah, tell me what merit our gathering

Arabic text: هٰذَا تَحْتَ الْكِسَاءِ مِنَ الْفَضْلِ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ
Translation: Under this cloak has with Allah?"

Arabic text: فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ
Translation: The Prophet said:

Arabic text: وَالَّذِيْ بَعَثَنِيْ بِالْحَقِّ نَبِيًّا
Translation: "By Him Who sent me with the truth as a Prophet

Arabic text: وَاصْطَفَانِيْ بِالرِّسَالَةِ نَجِيًّا
Translation: And chose me with the message as a confidant

Arabic text: مَا ذُكِرَ خَبَرُنَا هٰذَا فِيْ مَحْفِلٍ مِنْ مَحَافِلِ
Translation: This event of ours is not mentioned in any gathering

Arabic text: اَهْلِ الْأَرْضِ وَفِيْهِ جَمْعٌ مِنْ شِيْعَتِنَا وَمُحِبِّيْنَا
Translation: On earth in which our Shia and lovers are present

Arabic text: اِلَّا وَنَزَلَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ الرَّحْمَةُ
Translation: Without mercy descending upon them

Arabic text: وَحَفَّتْ بِهِمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَاسْتَغْفَرَتْ لَهُمْ اِلَى اَنْ يَتَفَرَّقُوْا
Translation: And angels surrounding them, asking forgiveness for them until they disperse."

Arabic text: فَقَالَ عَلِيٌّ اِذًا وَاللَّهِ فُزْنَا وَفَازَ شِيْعَتُنَا وَرَبِّ الْكَعْبَةِ
Translation: Ali said, "Then, by Allah, we have succeeded, and our Shia have succeeded, by the Lord of the Kaaba!"

Arabic text: فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ثَانِيًا
Translation: The Prophet said a second time:

Arabic text: يَا عَلِيُّ وَالَّذِيْ بَعَثَنِيْ بِالْحَقِّ نَبِيًّا
Translation: "O Ali, by Him Who sent me with the truth as a Prophet

Arabic text: وَاصْطَفَانِيْ بِالرِّسَالَةِ نَجِيًّا
Translation: And chose me with the message as a confidant

Arabic text: مَا ذُكِرَ خَبَرُنَا هٰذَا فِيْ مَحْفِلٍ مِنْ مَحَافِلِ اَهْلِ الْأَرْضِ
Translation: This event of ours is not mentioned in any gathering on earth

Arabic text: وَفِيْهِ جَمْعٌ مِنْ شِيْعَتِنَا وَمُحِبِّيْنَا
Translation: In which our Shia and lovers are present

Arabic text: وَفِيْهِمْ مَهْمُوْمٌ اِلَّا وَفَرَّجَ اللَّهُ هَمَّهُ
Translation: And among them is anyone distressed, without Allah relieving his distress

Arabic text: وَلَا مَغْمُوْمٌ اِلَّا وَكَشَفَ اللَّهُ غَمَّهُ
Translation: Nor anyone sorrowful, without Allah removing his sorrow

Arabic text: وَلَا طَالِبُ حَاجَةٍ اِلَّا وَقَضَى اللَّهُ حَاجَتَهُ
Translation: Nor anyone with a need, without Allah fulfilling his need."

Arabic text: فَقَالَ عَلِيٌّ اِذًا وَاللَّهِ فُزْنَا وَسُعِدْنَا
Translation: Ali said, "Then, by Allah, we have succeeded and are blessed

Arabic text: وَكَذٰلِكَ شِيْعَتُنَا فَازُوْا وَسُعِدُوْا فِيْ الدُّنْيَا وَالْأَخِرَةِ وَرَبِّ الْكَعْبَةِ
Translation: And likewise, our Shia have succeeded and are blessed in this world and the Hereafter, by the Lord of the Kaaba!"

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
